text: {"lessons":["Taking profits in stages can reduce regret, but selling winners too early may leave substantial upside behind; I should base trims on valuation and portfolio risk, not gains alone.","A stock can fall after I sell it or rise after I sell it, so I should avoid treating realized gains as proof that a trade was right and review decisions against my plan.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should set clear rebalancing and risk limits in advance rather than let either the pleasure of locking in gains or the pain of selling at a loss drive my trades."]}
